access_boundary: This record represents the gpt-audio release identified by its single documented snapshot, gpt-audio-2025-08-28, which the gpt-audio name resolves to. OpenAI marks the model Deprecated and lists gpt-audio for removal on January 20, 2027, naming gpt-audio-1.5 as the replacement. The gpt-audio-mini sibling (whose name resolves to a different snapshot), gpt-audio-1.5, the realtime and transcription models, the earlier gpt-4o-audio-preview releases, the Realtime API, fine-tuned derivatives, and later generations are separate service or model boundaries.
strengths: OpenAI documents audio and text as both input and output, the dated snapshot, limits, endpoints, and rate limits on the first-party model page
The deprecations page gives a notification date, a removal date, and a named replacement, and Azure Foundry lists the same version
tradeoffs: OpenAI has deprecated the model and set removal for January 20, 2027, so the record has a short remaining service life
No developer-published weights are available for self-operation, and OpenAI's page documents no structured-output support
